description: As the chief election officers in California and Michigan, we are charged with ensuring and protecting the votes of over 30 million Americans -- roughly 20% of the total registered voters in our country. We work to make sure that every eligible citizen is registered, has the information they need to vote, has their vote counted correctly and can have rightly placed faith in a complex electoral process -- one made more onerous by the continuing Covid-19 pandemic.
title: [CNN] If voters don't stop it, election deniers could kill American democracy - Shirley Weber for Secretary of State
